event.text: Have you coughed up any blood, or noticed blood in your sputum?
event.why: Hemoptysis would strengthen suspicion for pulmonary tuberculosis or other serious respiratory pathology and could affect urgency and initial workup.

event.text: Please be seen in person today at a clinic or urgent care that can do a chest X-ray and sputum testing — your three weeks of cough with night sweats and unintended weight loss need testing for tuberculosis. Call ahead and wear a mask so they can arrange airborne precautions. Go to an emergency department now if you cough up blood, become short of breath at rest, or feel faint.
